data.name: Lignification
data.description: You can turn a creature into wood %1/day. As a standard action, you may direct your gaze against a single creature within 30 feet. The targeted creature (along with all its carried gear) must make a Fortitude save (DC %2) or turn into a mindless, inert statue made out of wood for %3 rounds. This ability otherwise functions as a flesh to stone spell, except the target turns to wood instead of stone. This can be reversed by any effect that can reverse flesh to stone.|LignificationTimes|LignificationDC|LignificationDuration
